app.name: WC04 Camera (experimental)
app.long_description: Experimental UVC photo capture for the 057e:030a WC04 camera. Requires IOS58 and writable SD. A captures, 1 selects 320x240 or 640x480, 2 scans, HOME exits. This version queues four USB transfers to reduce gaps in reception and waits for all transfers on stop. Earlier testing received JPEG fragments but no complete photo; successful capture remains unverified. Includes timestamped diagnostics. No live viewfinder. If cancellation waits for USB, unplug the camera to release the transfers.
